g.text: /delete Delete rows from the current table matching --where
/dump Dump the current table to a CSV file (--path/--overwrite)
/empty Delete all rows from the current table
/help Show all commands, or /help <command> for details on one
/load Load a CSV into a new table (--path/--table/--overwrite)
/refresh Refresh the table list and SQL views
/sql Run raw SQL across every table in the database
/update Update rows in the current table (--set-clause/--where)
